description:
Create a workspace in NinjaTrader 8 containing two separate Instrument Link groups to monitor the market and a specific stock simultaneously.

1. Market Group (Red Link): Open a Chart and a SuperDOM for 'SPY'. Link both to the Red instrument link.
2. Stock Group (Blue Link): Open a Chart and a Time & Sales window for 'AAPL'. Link both to the Blue instrument link.

Ensure no other windows are open (except the Control Center). Save the workspace when complete.
